name: EPIC 242220705
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 11, 11.8 solar radii and 1.37 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 242220705 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.763585 (16th-84th percentiles 11.103045-12.438812), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 242220705 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.367423 (16th-84th percentiles 1.198003-1.557798), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 242220705: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4602.2144 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 242220705 (K2 campaign 11): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2150.117188 (16th-84th percentiles 2031.074219-2277.539062), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 2.99 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,150 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 11, give 1.37 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,602 K at its surface.
